reason: I might take the free call and look at the 15 companies, that costs me nothing. But signing a pilot means taking it to my partner, and right now all I have to show him is a Sofia agency that sounds like the other three LinkedIn pitches I get every week, with one logistics client as proof. That won't get through our sign-off this month.
objection: One client with 45 meetings is not proof for a wholesaler like me. Logistics is not distribution. I don't know who these people are, and I'd be putting my name on messages to buyers in a market where I can't afford a bad first impression.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies included names I recognise as real buyers I couldn't reach myself, and they gave me a reference I could call from a wholesale or distribution company. Then I'd have something to put in front of my partner.
